policies.title: Named ordinary passports: Algeria visa-free short visit
policies.summary: The current official MFA diplomatic-post schedule expressly sets an all-non-Algerian default and names these ordinary nationalities as its visa-exempt exceptions. This is a direct nationality schedule, not a conclusion from an online application channel or from an omitted country.
conditions: The schedule names nationals, while separately listing diplomatic and official-passport exemptions. This policy is therefore limited to ordinary passport nationality and does not extend special-document privileges to other passports.

No current official source in this batch states a nationality-wide exemption duration, ports, fee, onward-ticket, accommodation, health or extension rule. Admission, public-order and security decisions remain case-specific.

The Dublin MFA mission page omits Morocco, but two separate current MFA-post schedules (Oslo and London) expressly include it in the same closed ordinary-nationality list. Morocco is assigned on that corroborated direct evidence; the unexplained Dublin omission remains a source-quality risk.
The official Grand Sud organized-tourist arrival measure and the separate Algerian-national/foreign-passport document exception are conditional routes, not ordinary passport-nationality exemptions.

Work, residence, family, medical, study, business-only, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and stateless-document routes are outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline. The law remains subject to international agreements and reciprocity.

policies.title: All other ordinary passports: Algeria advance consular visitor visa
policies.summary: The MFA schedule expressly answers that all non-Algerians require a visa except its closed named exemption list. Combined with the central MFA instruction to obtain that visa before travel from a diplomatic or consular post, this establishes the remaining ordinary-passport complement as visa_required, not evisa or visa_on_arrival.
conditions: This is the central MFA's advance diplomatic-or-consular process. Downloadable application forms are not electronic visa issuance, and no current official source reviewed here establishes an ordinary-passport visa-on-arrival or eVisa alternative for this cohort.

The central MFA guidance requires a passport valid at least six months, travel-assistance/repatriation insurance, photos and the purpose-specific documents; tourist applicants need legalized accommodation, hotel booking or a travel-agency attestation. The competent mission is normally the applicant's place of habitual residence.

The law sets a maximum consular-visa validity of two years and a maximum stay of 90 days per entry; actual type, duration, entries, fee, grant, extension and admission remain visa- and case-specific. It also requires sufficient means and permits refusal on public-order, State-security or fundamental-interest grounds.

The official Great South measure offers an arrival regularisation visa only to foreign tourist groups travelling through an organized tourism framework, with a stay no longer than 30 days. Its route, agency and case conditions do not establish nationality-wide visa-on-arrival access.

Do not apply this passport-nationality baseline to holders of diplomatic, official, service, crew, UN or other special documents, to residents or workers, to family and other purpose-specific visas, to transit or border regularisation, or to an Algerian national travelling with a foreign passport and separate Algerian biometric passport or identity document. Those are conditional/document cases, not an ordinary foreign-passport nationality route.

application.label: Algerian Ministry of Foreign Affairs visa guidance
application.processingTime: The central guidance gives a 48-hour issuance statement only for organized tourists after the complete file reaches the competent mission; it does not promise a general processing time.
steps: Download and complete the visa form in duplicate, then gather the passport, photographs, travel insurance and purpose-specific supporting documents.
Submit the application to the Algerian Embassy or Consulate responsible for the applicant's usual residence, with the required consular fee.
Obtain the visa before travel and present the travel document and visa for border examination; a visa does not remove admissibility and security controls.

policies.title: Algerian citizens: national-passport return
policies.summary: The Interior Ministry's current national-passport guidance directly states that the document permits its holder to leave Algeria or return to it under the applicable law. The same-country ordinary-passport pair is therefore citizenship, not a foreign visitor-visa classification.
conditions: This records only the citizen return function of an Algerian national passport. It does not decide passport issuance or validity, dual nationality, identity checks, customs, health, criminal process, security screening or other border formalities.

conflicts.explanation: Hong Kong is not among the MFA schedule's closed ordinary-nationality exemption list, which states that all other non-Algerians require a visa in advance.
The current MFA ordinary-nationality schedule expressly names Maldives as visa-exempt.

Two current MFA-post schedules (Oslo and London) expressly include Morocco in the closed ordinary-nationality exemption list. A Dublin-page omission is recorded as a source-quality risk, not sufficient to displace the matching direct schedules.
